A cloak woven from dense mana fabric, capable of drawing in surrounding energy and holding it as an invisible protective layer.

When taking damage, forms a barrier around the wearer that completely intercepts incoming damage, consuming %1$s mana per point of damage prevented. If there is not enough mana for full absorption, the barrier weakens and allows the remaining damage through.
If the barrier triggers again within %3$s seconds of the previous activation, incoming damage is additionally reduced by %2$s%%, increasing with consecutive hits.
Part of the absorbed damage energy is converted into healing, restoring %4$s%% of the prevented damage as health.
Absorbed damage is redistributed among targets within a radius of %5$s blocks.
+1 experience point for each instance of damage absorbed.
+1 experience point for each target damaged by redistribution.
relics.description.flaming_bracer.descri: A fragment of ancient armor containing living flame that does not fade with time or battle. Its heat does more than burn—it obeys the will of its wielder, igniting at the right moment and turning every movement into a source of destructive energy.
relics.description.flaming_bracer.abilit: With each attack, has a %1$s%% chance to unleash a burst of magical fire: the target is paralyzed for %2$s seconds, unable to move or act, and magical fire is created beneath them, dealing %3$s damage and setting them ablaze.
Grants the wearer complete immunity to magical fire damage.
While standing in magical fire, the wearer restores %4$s health per second.
Attacks against targets standing in magical fire deal %5$s%% increased damage.
+1 experience point for each successful ability trigger.
+1 experience point for each second of healing in magical fire.
+1 experience point for each attack dealing bonus damage.
relics.description.quantum_bubble.descri: A weightless device where space behaves differently than it should. Its surface shimmers like a thin membrane between worlds, and even the fastest objects freeze for a moment inside. The bubble does not destroy threats—it stops them, as if time itself ceases to exist for the captured strike.
relics.description.quantum_bubble.abilit: Stores up to %1$s charges, restoring one every %2$s seconds. When an enemy projectile approaches the wearer, it is automatically captured into a bubble, consuming one charge.
Breaking a bubble releases a burst of energy that blinds all targets within %4$s blocks for %5$s seconds, causing them to lose sight of the wearer.
When a bubble breaks, captured projectiles are empowered and redirected toward their original owner.
If at least one bubble with a captured projectile exists within %3$s blocks of the wearer, any incoming damage is completely negated, after which one of the bubbles bursts.
+1 experience point for each captured projectile.
+1 experience point for each instance of fully negated damage.
relics.description.staff_of_the_spectral: A one-of-a-kind staff whose shaft holds the fragile boundary between the material world and the shadows beyond. Its surface seems only partially present in reality, leaving faint distortions as it moves. Those who wield it can briefly step beyond ordinary space, becoming something between body and spirit.

Upon activation, puts the wearer into a spectral state and propels them forward in the direction they are looking, allowing free movement through blocks. During movement, surrounding blocks temporarily shift into a spectral form that does not obstruct passage. The ability consumes one charge per second of active movement and ends when charges are depleted or movement stops. The staff stores up to %1$s charges and restores one charge every %3$s seconds.
While active, all entities within %2$s blocks become visible through obstacles.
If the ability ends in an unsafe location, the wearer is automatically returned to the last safe position.
While active, the wearer gains immortality.
+1 experience point for each second spent in spectral form.
relics.description.archmage_glove.descri: An ancient glove infused with remnants of forgotten spellcasting techniques. Its threads weave hidden cycles of repetition into every cast spell, causing magic to echo.
relics.description.archmage_glove.abilit: Each cast spell has a %1$s%% chance to trigger a multicast chain, automatically repeating up to %2$s additional times. Subsequent casts occur sequentially with a short delay, fully replicating the original spell’s effects, including damage, targets, and behavior.
While a multicast chain is active and awaiting the next trigger, incoming damage to the wearer is reduced by %3$s%%.
Each time multicast fails to trigger, the chance of the next trigger increases by %4$s%%. The bonus resets after a successful multicast.
Each additional multicast has a %5$s%% chance to refund %6$s%% of the base spell cost as mana.
+1 experience point for each additional multicast trigger.
reliquified_ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph: Marks a spell to trigger the Archmage's Glove.
